land-preparation.intro: Clearing comes before every planting season. Overgrown plots, field edges and the rows between tree crops take a lot of time to clear by hand with a cutlass. A shoulder-carried brush cutter lets one person cover far more ground while standing upright, cutting weeds, tall grass and bush with a spinning blade. It suits farmers preparing new plots, plantation and orchard owners keeping rows open, and anyone who clears compounds and roadsides for a living. ABE Agro Hub supplies land clearing equipment to farmers across Ghana from our base in Kasoa. Tap Get quote on any machine and our sales team will reply on WhatsApp with price, availability and delivery.
tips: Think about what you cut most. A metal blade suits bush and thick weeds, while a nylon line head suits grass around trees and buildings.
Two-stroke engines run on a petrol and oil mix. Follow the ratio in the manual, because the wrong mix damages the engine.
Wear eye protection, boots and long trousers, and keep the blade guard fitted. Blades can throw stones a long way.

faqs.question: Can one person use a brush cutter all day?
faqs.answer: It is built for long sessions, with a padded harness that carries the weight on the shoulders. Take regular breaks and refuel with the engine off and cool.

faqs.question: Will a brush cutter clear small trees?
faqs.answer: It is made for weeds, grass and bush. Tell our sales team what you need to clear and they can advise whether it suits your land.

planting.intro: Good spacing at planting shapes the whole season. When seed goes in at an even depth and distance, plants come up together and share light, water and nutrients more fairly. A hand-pushed precision planter opens the soil, drops the seed at a set spacing and covers it in one pass, which saves bending and helps cut seed waste compared with planting by hand. Interchangeable seed plates let the same planter handle maize, groundnut, beans, soybean and sorghum. It suits smallholders who want better results from each bag of seed. ABE Agro Hub delivers nationwide from Kasoa. Tap Get quote and our sales team will reply on WhatsApp with price and availability.
tips: Match the seed plate to your seed size. The right plate is what keeps spacing even along the row.
Prepare the soil first. A hand planter works best on land that has been cleared and loosened.
Plan your rows and walk them at a steady pace so seed depth and spacing stay consistent.

faqs.question: Which crops can I plant with it?
faqs.answer: Maize, groundnut, beans, soybean and sorghum, using the matching seed plate.

faqs.question: Does it need fuel or electricity?
faqs.answer: No. It is pushed by hand, so there is no fuel or power to pay for.

crop-protection.intro: Pests and disease can take a large share of a harvest, and reaching the whole plant is half the job. A motorized mist blower uses a fast stream of air to break spray liquid into fine droplets and carry them deep into dense canopies, including tall cocoa, coffee and citrus trees that a knapsack sprayer struggles to reach. Worn as a backpack, it lets one person cover plantations and vegetable plots quickly. It suits cocoa farmers, spraying gangs and vegetable growers across Ghana. ABE Agro Hub delivers nationwide from our base in Kasoa. Tap Get quote and our sales team will reply on WhatsApp with price, availability and delivery details.
tips: Wear gloves, a face shield or goggles, a mask and long clothes every time you spray.
Follow the product label for mixing rates. Your local extension officer can advise on what to use for your crop.
Rinse the tank and lines after use, and never leave chemical sitting in the machine.

faqs.question: Can a mist blower reach the top of cocoa trees?
faqs.answer: It is designed to carry droplets deep into dense canopies such as cocoa. Tell our sales team about your farm and they can advise.

faqs.question: What does it run on?
faqs.answer: It has a petrol engine and is carried as a backpack, so it works anywhere on the farm with no mains power.

irrigation.intro: Reliable water lets you grow through the dry season instead of waiting for rain. Our irrigation range covers portable petrol and diesel water pumps, belt-driven and larger diesel pump sets, electric pressure pumps and PVC lay-flat hose to carry water to your beds. Small petrol pumps suit vegetable plots near a river or well. Diesel pumps and pump sets suit larger fields, rice schemes and long pumping hours. Pressure pumps suit homes, drip lines and overhead tanks. The right choice depends on your water source, how far and how high you must lift the water, and your land size. ABE Agro Hub delivers water pumps across Ghana from Kasoa. Tap Get quote for price and availability on WhatsApp.
tips: Measure the distance and height from your water source to your field before you choose. Both affect which pump will work.
Check the suction lift. If your water level is too far below the pump, it will struggle to draw water.
Choose your hose diameter to match the pump outlet, and have enough length to reach the far end of your land.
Diesel usually suits long pumping hours, while petrol pumps are lighter and easier to carry.

faqs.question: What pump do I need for a small vegetable farm?
faqs.answer: Many vegetable growers start with a portable 3-inch petrol pump and lay-flat hose. Send us your land size and the distance to your water, and our sales team can advise.

faqs.question: Do I need to buy a hose separately?
faqs.answer: Hose is listed as its own product. Add it to your quote list with your pump so the sales team can quote them together.

post-harvest.intro: Threshing by hand is slow, and grain left waiting in the field or in the store is at risk. A motorised thresher separates grain from cobs, stalks and pods quickly, and a built-in fan helps clean it as it goes. The electric maize thresher strips dried cobs for farms and aggregation centres, while the large Model 900 handles several crops and suits community and contract threshing, where it can earn income from other farmers' harvests as well as your own. Dry crops thresh best, so plan your drying before the machine arrives. ABE Agro Hub delivers threshers nationwide from Kasoa. Tap Get quote and our sales team will reply on WhatsApp with price and availability.
tips: Decide what you will thresh. A maize sheller suits maize, while a multi-crop thresher handles other cereals and legumes with matching screens.
Check your power first. Some threshers need a motor and others a sizeable diesel engine.
Dry your crop well before threshing. Damp grain threshes poorly and is more likely to break.
Keep belts guarded and hands clear of the feed opening while the machine is running.

faqs.question: Can I thresh for other farmers with these machines?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Model 900 is on a tyre rack, so it can be moved between farms, and many owners offer contract threshing.

faqs.question: Which crops does the Model 900 handle?
faqs.answer: Typically maize, sorghum, millet, soybean, beans, rice and wheat with the matching screens. Our sales team will confirm this for your crop.

rice-processing.intro: Local rice sells better when it is clean and well milled. Our rice processing range covers the machines in a small or medium milling line: combined SB10 and SB30 rice mills that clean, hull and whiten paddy in one machine, the diesel-driven SB10D for areas with no mains power, the CHP150 whitener, the JLX destoner that removes stones and sand, and bucket elevators that move grain between machines. A single combined mill can be enough to start a village milling service, and you can add machines as your business grows. ABE Agro Hub supplies rice mill machines across Ghana from Kasoa. Tap Get quote and our sales team will reply on WhatsApp with price, availability and delivery.
tips: Start from your power. If you have no reliable mains supply, look at diesel-driven options.
Estimate how much paddy you will mill each day, and choose capacity that leaves room to grow.
Destoning makes a real difference to the rice you sell, because customers notice stones quickly.
Plan your space, including room for bagging and for moving paddy in and rice out.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the SB10 and the SB30?
faqs.answer: The SB30 is the larger of the two, with higher paddy capacity and a bigger motor. Compare them side by side using the Compare option.

faqs.question: Can I run a rice mill without electricity?
faqs.answer: Yes. The SB10D is coupled to a diesel engine, and the SB10 and SB30 also have diesel engine options.

grain-milling.intro: Every community needs flour, and a grinding mill can be a business on its own. Our grain milling range includes corn mills for maize flour and meal, disc mills for fine flour and spices, hammer mills for animal feed ingredients, and a grinding mill with a cyclone that drops flour cleanly into a bag. Corn mills are a common choice for a neighbourhood kiosk. Hammer mills suit poultry and livestock feed. Disc mills suit finer food products. Each runs on an electric motor, and several can run on an engine where there is no mains power. ABE Agro Hub delivers milling machines across Ghana from Kasoa. Tap Get quote for price and availability on WhatsApp.
tips: Choose by what you will grind most: flour for people, or coarser meal for animals.
Check whether you have the power supply for the motor size, or plan for an engine instead.
Ask about screens. Screen size sets how fine the product comes out.
Think about dust. A cyclone helps collect flour and keeps your workspace cleaner.

faqs.question: What is the difference between a hammer mill and a disc mill?
faqs.answer: A hammer mill breaks material against a screen and is the standard for animal feed. A disc mill grinds between toothed plates and produces fine flour and spice powder.

faqs.question: Can a corn mill grind other grains?
faqs.answer: Yes. As well as maize, it also handles millet, sorghum and rice.

food-processing.intro: Food processing machines take the hardest work out of everyday Ghanaian foods. Our range includes cassava graters for gari and agbelima, fufu machines for homes, chop bars and restaurants, pepper mills, wet and dry grinding mills for market grinding services, multi-purpose grinders and groundnut paste machines. Many of these can start or grow a small business, whether that is a grinding service at the market or a chop bar serving more customers at lunchtime. Some run on mains power and others on petrol, so check what suits your location. ABE Agro Hub delivers nationwide from Kasoa. Tap Get quote on any machine and our sales team will reply on WhatsApp with price and availability.
tips: List what you will process, then look for one machine that handles the foods you make most.
Check your power. Food machines vary from small countertop units to larger motors, and some use a petrol engine.
Choose parts that are easy to clean, because food machines need washing after every use.
Size the machine for your busiest hour, not your average day.

faqs.question: Which fufu machine is right for me?
faqs.answer: The compact 2-in-1 suits homes and small vendors, while the commercial machine is built for chop bars, restaurants and caterers.

faqs.question: What can a cassava grater be used for?
faqs.answer: It turns peeled cassava into a fine wet mash for gari, agbelima, akple and starch.

groundnut-processing.intro: Groundnuts are worth more the further you take them. A motorised sheller removes shells from dried pods with little breakage, ready for seed, oil, paste or sale. A huller then rubs the red skins off roasted kernels to give clean white nuts for paste, snacks and confectionery. Together with a groundnut paste machine from our food processing range, they make up a small line from farm gate to finished paste. Shelling by hand is slow work, so a sheller also suits those offering a service to other farmers in the community. ABE Agro Hub delivers groundnut machines across Ghana from Kasoa. Tap Get quote and our sales team will reply on WhatsApp with price and availability.
tips: Check the moisture of your pods. Shelling results and breakage depend on it.
If you plan to make paste, consider a huller as well, because clean kernels give a better product.
Choose your power first: electric motor where you have mains supply, or an engine where you do not.

faqs.question: What is the difference between a sheller and a huller?
faqs.answer: A sheller removes the outer shell from dried pods. A huller removes the thin red skin from the kernels, usually after roasting.

faqs.question: Can I make groundnut paste with these machines?
faqs.answer: They prepare the nuts. For the paste itself, see the Groundnut Paste Machine in Food Processing.

animal-feed.intro: Feed is one of the biggest costs in raising animals, and making your own gives you more control over what goes into it. A multi-purpose chaff cutter chops green forage, grass, maize stalks and straw, and crushes dry grain for cattle, sheep, goats, rabbits and poultry. A feed pelletizer presses mixed meal into firm pellets for poultry, fish, pigs and rabbits. Pair them with a hammer mill from our grain milling range to grind your ingredients first. These machines suit farms feeding their own animals and small businesses selling feed to others. ABE Agro Hub delivers nationwide from Kasoa. Tap Get quote and our sales team will reply on WhatsApp with price and availability.
tips: Decide which animals you are feeding. Forage suits cattle, sheep and goats, while pellets suit poultry, fish and pigs.
Check your power supply. These machines use electric motors, and pelletizers can need a large one.
Plan the full process. Pelleting needs ingredients ground and mixed beforehand.
Ask about die sizes, because the die sets the pellet size.

faqs.question: What else do I need to make pellets?
faqs.answer: Ingredients are usually ground first, so many buyers pair a pelletizer with a hammer mill. Our sales team can advise on a full set.

faqs.question: Can the chaff cutter handle dry grain?
faqs.answer: Yes. Forage goes through the side conveyor, and dry grain and tubers go in the top hopper to be crushed.

engines-power.intro: Many farm machines need a separate engine or motor to drive them, and choosing the right one keeps them working well. Our range includes water-cooled diesel engines for rice mills, corn mills, pumps and threshers, air-cooled petrol engines for small pumps, grinders and sprayers, and electric motors for sites with mains power. Diesel suits long working hours and places with no grid. Petrol is lighter and suits smaller, portable jobs. Electric motors are cheaper to run and maintain where supply is reliable. The PLUS.HONDAY GX200 is a separate brand and is not a Honda engine. ABE Agro Hub delivers nationwide from Kasoa. Tap Get quote for price and availability on WhatsApp.
tips: Match the power to the machine. Tell us which machine you are driving, and our sales team can check it.
Check the speed and pulley setup, because belt-driven machines need the right speed.
For electric motors, check whether your site has single- or three-phase supply before ordering.

faqs.question: Should I choose diesel, petrol or electric?
faqs.answer: Electric is cheapest to run where you have reliable mains supply. Diesel suits long hours off-grid. Petrol suits lighter, portable jobs.

faqs.question: Is the PLUS.HONDAY engine made by Honda?
faqs.answer: No. PLUS.HONDAY is a separate brand and is not a Honda engine.

spare-parts.intro: A worn part can quietly reduce the quality of everything your machine produces. In a rice mill, the perforated screen in the whitening chamber lets bran pass out while keeping the rice in, and a damaged or worn screen lowers milling quality, so it should be replaced regularly. We list the SB30 rice huller sieve here for owners of SB-30 rice mills. If you run a different model, check the dimensions with our sales team before ordering. Need a part you cannot see here? Send us the machine name and model on WhatsApp, and we can tell you what is possible. ABE Agro Hub delivers across Ghana from our base in Kasoa.
tips: Have your machine's model name ready, and a photo of the worn part if you can.
Check your sieve regularly, because worn screens reduce milling quality before they fail completely.
Consider keeping a spare, so a worn part does not stop your mill during a busy period.

faqs.question: Will this sieve fit my rice mill?
faqs.answer: It is listed for the SB-30 rice mill. For other models, send our sales team your model so they can confirm the dimensions.

faqs.question: Can I ask for a part that is not listed?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send the machine name and model on WhatsApp and our sales team will let you know.

utility.intro: A pressure washer makes quick work of cleaning jobs that take hours with a bucket and brush. It sends a high-pressure stream of water to clean cars, tractors, farm machinery and buildings, and it helps keep animal houses and work areas hygienic. It can also be the start of a car washing bay. Engine-driven versions work without mains power, which helps at sites away from the grid. Before you buy, think about your water supply and where the machine will be used. ABE Agro Hub delivers utility equipment across Ghana from our base in Kasoa. Tap Get quote and our sales team will reply on WhatsApp with price, availability and delivery.
tips: Think about your water supply, because a pressure washer needs a steady flow to work properly.
Choose engine-driven if your site has no reliable mains power.
Wear eye protection and closed shoes, and never point the lance at people or animals.

faqs.question: Is this only for cars?
faqs.answer: No. It also cleans tractors, farm machinery and buildings, and helps with farm hygiene.

faqs.question: Can it work without mains electricity?
faqs.answer: Engine-driven versions work without mains power. Tell our sales team what you need.
